notes.title: Release of our strategy Last Day of Rome!
notes.notes:
Today is a big day. Our biggest game started - Last Day of Rome. It has been a long way. In Early Access, the game occupied 600 megabytes, and now 2200.

For a long time, the Roman Empire subjugates and captures everything in its path. Conceited and greedy for power Romans never met worthy rivals on their way until they got to the lands of the barbarians. The invaders don't tolerate anything except total obedience, taking our fellows into slavery, taking away the lands that we conquered with sweat and blood. That's enough! The time has come to show what we can do! Let's take up arms, brethren, and together we will succeed in crushing the insatiable Roman Empire!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015090/Last_Day_of_Rome/

notes.title: Update (Campaign)
notes.notes:
Previously, it was not clear to the players that the “Campaign” is not the main game mode. Apparently the name was misleading.
The main game with the adjustment of cities, science and battles are available on the buttons "New Game" and then with the help of Load / Save.
The Campaign itself is an auxiliary part of the game, in which the emphasis is placed on chronological battles for a particular faction.
After editing - "Campaign" will be available to the player only after he passes the tutorial in a normal game and familiarizes himself with at least the basics of the Third Front.

It is a pity that some of the players could not fully appreciate the game, but went into the “Campaign” and stopped at this, in fact, not seeing 80% of the functionality.
Hopefully, after updating such incidents, there will be no more.

notes.title: One more update (AI)
notes.notes:
Yesterday we updated such a thing as AI. Earlier in the game, defense in enemy cities was static. Now we have reworked the system and added artificial intelligence (finally! :))
Now the enemy will build armies in the territories under their control and regularly attack you. You will be able to see where the potential strike will be directed and prepare for it by building defense in the necessary cities.

Don't forget about the Defense Buildings, because now their role has grown. Also now there is a real opportunity not to build defense in all cities, but only in front-line areas, where the enemy is preparing to strike.
Thanks for your support! :)

notes.title: The second Global update is "Events"!
notes.notes:
Only a few hours left before the release. And we managed to finish the work on new update, for which you voted in the second voting!)
The concept of population groups is introduced into the game:
- Workers
- Peasants
- Army
- Civilians
Every few days there will be one random event out of the available ones - and you will have to make a choice of how to act in this or that situation. The change in the attitude of a particular group will depend on your choice. If the respect level is too low, you will receive a fine corresponding to the group. If it's too high, then you will get a bonus on the contrary. You will have to decide for yourself which bonuses are more important for you and which group of people you need to support more.
This is the second global update that we introduce on the basis of your vote and we are really proud of it! :)
Thank you for supporting us and for helping make the game better! :)[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32205375/553a6a5b1dcc39b7654ecff98d7b6773ba29d902.png[/img]

notes.title: Finally! Global update "Campaign"!
notes.notes:
A month ago you voted for the "Campaign"update and we will introduce it today. It remains only 5 hours before we bring this update into the game.
Finally, you can try your hand at being a real strategist. The battles in which you will participate are divided into three campaigns:
- For the Allies
- For Germany
- For the USSR
Each campaign includes 20 battles in historical chronology, as it was in World War II. Each battle has three levels of difficulty: easy, normal and insane. :)
Depending on what level of difficulty you are winning the battle - you get accordingly 1, 2 or 3 stars. The more stars you have, the higher your rank in this Campaign.
We tried very hard to make the Campaigns interesting and not all of our team members were able to complete the game at the maximum level of difficulty. But it's probably more interesting to play this way. :)
Thank you for choosing this update! It turned out really cool! :)[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32205375/e3be229c651bd0fe0e8733d93240c5a073a04555.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Sixth global Update
notes.notes:
Today we uploaded the sixth big update. In fact, it's really big. :) Most likely the game will be quite different now. :) 
1. We have changed the balance of development. Now the progress of development will be much more smooth. There are 4 times more levels of the Main Building now, but now each level gives something of its own (earlier with the improvement of the Main Building it was possible to improve each building by 1 level). 
2. Now the player has the opportunity to automatically put the card in battle by clicking the card 2 times with the left mouse button. This will put the card on the field towards the opponent against which it has the maximum percentage of attack. 
3. Now in the main window above the "Central District" button is written how many buildings you can upgrade. 
4. We added hints for those cases when the player doesn't have enough money for something (somewhere we added pop-up hints, somewhere a red font on the price). 
5. Now if in quest city there is less defense than in other cities, then the icon changes to one sword (the icon of the enemy's minimum defense). 
6. At your request, we added the sorting of cities in the window with all the cities. 
7. We fixed a number of bugs (for example, now the tooltips are closed when clicking on any area of the screen). 
8. Minor changes (like the button "In battle" which now flickers when all the places on the battlefield are occupied, pop-up hints for improving or hiring units).
In addition, we are continuing to work on "Campaign" update - most likely, we will be able to please you with this update next week! :) 
Thank you for supporting us! :)

notes.title: Information about the update "Campaign" (+photo)
notes.notes:
Good afternoon! 
Today we want to show you the first part of the update, which is prepared based on results of the vote. 
You will be able to choose from 3 historical campaigns: 
- For the USSR 
- For the Germany 
- For the Allied forces in Europe. 
Each campaign will include 20 battles, restored in historical sequence. Maybe later we'll add one more campaign (alternative history) for each fraction. But for now we are preparing the Campaign 100% based on the real history.
The work is well under way - we hope to please you with an update in late April! 
Thank you for supporting us! :)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32205375/e3be229c651bd0fe0e8733d93240c5a073a04555.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fifth update (bugfix) + announcement
notes.notes:
Today we upload bug fixes. 
1. We corrected text display in some windows. A number of moments were found where instead of text there were keys (for example tutorial_step2_1 instead of the text of this tutorial) 
2. We fixed the bug in the hiring units window. Previously, some units after hiring didn't appear in the window until the player reloaded. 
And we still working on updates. 
Tomorrow we will share with you more info about the "Campaign" and show you first art of it :)

notes.title: Fourth big update into a game!)
notes.notes:
Today we continued to make updates that you asked in your videos for or we just noticed things we can improve.
1. We added speed control with the keys! Now the keys "1", "2" and "3" set the corresponding speed. A button to the left of "1" pauses the game.
2. We added explanations to the fight. Now it will be written why the division was killed (all soldiers in the detachment are dead or you have run out of ammunition).
3. We improved explanations to the diversions at the start.
4. We corrected the Chinese font. Now there won't be several fonts in one inscription. 
5. Time is no longer paused when there is a report on the capture of the city by the enemy. Previously it was inconvenient in case you speed up the time to save money for something.
6. We added new tooltips (more than 20).

Starting tomorrow, we are starting to work on the new functional for which you voted. The campaign is pretty good even now, and we are sure that you will like it :) Most likely the campaign will be available in 2-4 weeks.
Thank you for supporting us ;)

notes.title: Third big update last night
notes.notes:
We uploaded one more update last night.
1. Achievements. Yes, the achievements finally appeared on Steam. :) Now you see your progress in your profile.
2. Diversions will be more understandable due to the fact that at the beginning of the diversion you're going to see the field where you need to find diversionists, and unexplored territory will flash.
3. The assistant general in the two nations is displayed correctly (the general of the other nation was previously displayed).
4. We have changed the population system. Now every building of the Central District, the infrastructure in the cities and defensive structures give a certain population. In the future, we will also add that you lose units in battles and, accordingly, the population decreases. If the population wanes to 0, you lose.

Thank you for being with us. Today or tomorrow morning there will be another update, also quite massive. Thanks everyone who make videos about our game and helps us to see the game with your eyes and understand what exactly needs to be changed. Thanks for your support ;)

notes.title: Second update is online!
notes.notes:
Hello! Today we have the second update since the release. What interesting things have we updated?
1. For convenience, we made a accentuation for the city that the enemies had captured. Now when the enemy has captured your area - you see which city was captured directly on the map. Also highlighted the area in which the saboteurs invaded. Earlier I saw in lets play that some players dont understand this previosly.
2. Now in the Central District the demand of Main Building level is written as tooltip. Previously, players sometimes did not understand why they were not allowed to improve this or that building. Now it becomes clear thanks to a new tooltip)
3. We have updated the strength of the opponents when they are trying to capture your area. Now, if you build a minimum the cheapest defensive building - this city will stand up to the day 120. Now it is more logic in it)
4. We have slightly updated the location of the cities in the Alps. Several cities such as Munich were strongly knocked out from their real positions, but now it's much better. Corrected 10 cities.

We make the game for you) Thank you for supporting us!)

notes.title: First update)
notes.notes:
Today we have introduced a number of revisions. For the most part, today we fixed bugs. However, we added several updates.
1. Corrected the Chinese language. An annoying misunderstanding was corrected in the morning.
2. Added an announcement if your city is captured. Earlier there was no notification. Now the announcement speaks about the actions of the opponent. Also, we will soon make opponents weaker at the start. Many players says that the enemy is too strong and too active in the begining.
3. Added description in battle. When you select a unit, it is written on the battlefield what percentage of the attack your unit has against each specific opponent.
As you can see, we are actively improving the game. 
Also do not forget about voting. We want to make a game with you. So we want you to decide what to add next. And thank you for playing with us;)
